LanguageData.DeltaV_NavDragTip: Hold the left mouse button to pan; use the wheel to zoom. Click "Back to ship" to resume following. Closing the detailed map also restores ship following in the minimap.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavSearch: Search known places by name or faction. The list is independent of map zoom.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavBehind: The target is on the far side of the current view. Pan the detailed map to look around, or use its direction and distance.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavFitLimit: Zoomed out to the whole globe. The target bounds cannot fit completely in this view.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavScaleTip: Scale at the center of the view. Target distances follow the surface of the sphere.
LanguageData.DeltaV_NavCourseDesc: Locate the current lesson objective on the sector map without changing the piloting task.
